attrs.remaining_trust: The stripping is performed by this artifact on its own fixture, so `zero knowledge` means `this graph with these fields blanked` and not `a graph that arose with no knowledge in it`. A configuration reached by removal is not obviously the same object as one that was never populated — nothing here establishes that it is, and for this construction the two coincide only because operational() reads exactly the fields withoutDischarges() blanks.
attrs.rule: complete enumeration of a finite domain DEFINED by the artifact under test
